source: voice draft v1 (3:23), approved by Jay

lines.tts: [surprised, bright] 东坡先生？您怎么在买骨头？
lines.zh: 东坡先生？您怎么在买骨头？
lines.en: Master Dongpo? Why are you buying bones?

lines.tts: [cheerful, conspiratorial, leaning in] 惠州一天只杀一只羊，肉，得让给当官的。
lines.zh: 惠州一天只杀一只羊，肉，得让给当官的。
lines.en: Huizhou kills one sheep a day. The meat goes to the officials.

lines.tts: [puzzled] 您不也是官吗？
lines.en: Aren't you an official?

lines.tts: [laughing at himself] 我是被贬来的官。
lines.en: I'm the banished kind.

lines.tts: [delighted, like showing off treasure] 你看，骨头缝里，还有肉！
lines.en: Look! There's still meat between the bones!

card.zh: 他写信告诉弟弟：惠州一天杀一羊，他只买脊骨。
card.en: He wrote to his brother: Huizhou kills one sheep a day, and he buys only the spine.

lines.tts: [proud, demonstrating step by step] 煮熟，泡酒，撒盐，烤到微焦。
lines.zh: 煮熟，泡酒，撒盐，烤到微焦。
screens: 煮熟，泡酒，撒盐，烤到微焦。
lines.en: Boil it, soak it in wine, a pinch of salt, grill it till it just chars.

lines.tts: [blissful] 慢慢剔，能啃一整天，跟吃螃蟹一样。
lines.zh: 慢慢剔，能啃一整天，跟吃螃蟹一样。
lines.en: Pick at it slowly and it lasts all day. Like eating crab.

lines.tts: [curious] 那啃完的骨头，给狗吗？
lines.en: And when you're done, the bones go to the dog?

lines.tts: [mock-sorry, deadpan] 啃得这么干净，狗都不高兴。
lines.zh: 啃得这么干净，狗都不高兴。
screens: 啃得这么干净，狗都不高兴。
lines.en: Picked this clean? The dogs are not happy.

lines.tts: [to camera, laughing] 大文豪，跟狗抢饭吃。
lines.en: The great poet is stealing the dog's dinner.

lines.tts: [beaming] 我自己盖的房子。一家人，总算团聚了。
lines.zh: 我自己盖的房子。一家人，总算团聚了。
lines.en: I built this house myself. The whole family is finally together.

lines.tts: [curious] 您被贬过几次了？
lines.en: How many times have you been banished?

lines.tts: [counting on his fingers, cheerful] 黄州一次，惠州一次。
lines.en: Huangzhou once. Huizhou once.

lines.tts: [shrugging, light] 黄州那次，是因为写诗，坐了四个多月牢。
lines.zh: 黄州那次，是因为写诗，坐了四个多月牢。
lines.en: Huangzhou was for poems. Four months in prison first.

lines.tts: [fond, remembering] 黄州猪肉便宜，有钱人不吃，穷人不会煮。
lines.zh: 黄州猪肉便宜，有钱人不吃，穷人不会煮。
screens: 有钱人不吃，穷人不会煮。
lines.en: Pork in Huangzhou was dirt cheap. The rich wouldn't eat it, the poor didn't know how to cook it.

lines.tts: [savouring every word] 少放水，小火慢炖，火候到了，自然就香。
lines.zh: 少放水，小火慢炖，火候到了，自然就香。
lines.en: Not much water, a small fire, no hurry. When it's ready, it turns delicious all by itself.

lines.tts: [excited] 这就是东坡肉！
lines.en: That's Dongpo pork!

lines.tts: [amused, correcting her] 东坡，是我在黄州种地的那块坡。
lines.zh: 东坡，是我在黄州种地的那块坡。
lines.en: Dongpo, "East Slope", is the hillside I farmed in Huangzhou.

lines.tts: [amazed] “日啖荔枝三百颗”，真的假的？
lines.en: "Three hundred lychees a day", from your poem. Really?

lines.tts: [mock-solemn, then a wink] 诗嘛，要夸张一点。
lines.en: It's poetry. You exaggerate a little.

lines.tts: [deadpan] 一点。
lines.en: "A little."

lines.tts: [sincere] 被贬到这么远，您不难过吗？
lines.zh: 被贬到这么远，您不难过吗？
screens: 被贬到这么远，您不难过吗？
lines.en: Banished this far from home, aren't you sad?

lines.tts: [content, meaning it] 有荔枝吃，在这儿待一辈子都行。
lines.zh: 有荔枝吃，在这儿待一辈子都行。
lines.en: With lychees like these, I'd stay here for life.

lines.tts: [curious] 最近写新诗了吗？
lines.en: Written any new poems lately?

lines.tts: [drowsy, pleased with himself, reciting] 报道先生春睡美，道人轻打五更钟。
lines.zh: 报道先生春睡美，道人轻打五更钟。
lines.en: "Tell them the old man sleeps sweetly this spring; the monk rings the dawn bell gently, so as not to wake him."

lines.tts: [to camera, translating] 意思是：我在这儿，睡得可香了。
lines.zh: 意思是：我在这儿，睡得可香了。
lines.en: Translation: "I'm sleeping just great down here."

card.zh: 宋人笔记：诗传到京城，宰相笑：他还这么快活？
card.en: A Song-era note: the poem reached the capital. The chief minister laughed: "Still this happy?"

lines.tts: [loud, formal, reading] 苏轼，责授琼州别驾，昌化军安置！
lines.zh: 苏轼，责授琼州别驾，昌化军安置！
lines.en: Su Shi! Demoted to Assistant Prefect of Qiongzhou, confined at Changhua!

lines.tts: [lost] 穹州……是哪儿？
lines.en: Qiongzhou... where's that?

lines.tts: [stunned] 海南。
lines.en: Hainan. Across the sea.

lines.tts: [stunned, then genuinely curious] 海南，有什么好吃的？
lines.en: Hainan... so what's good to eat there?

lines.tts: [to camera, stunned, half laughing] 被贬到天边，他第一句问吃的。
lines.zh: 被贬到天边，他第一句问吃的。
lines.en: Banished to the edge of the world, and his first question is about food.

lines.tts: [hesitant] 家里人，不跟您去吗？
lines.en: Isn't the family going with you?

lines.tts: [matter-of-fact, kind] 只带小儿子。房子盖好了，给他们住。
lines.zh: 只带小儿子。房子盖好了，给他们住。
lines.en: Only my youngest. The house is finished. They'll live in it.

lines.tts: [curious] 您在写什么？
lines.en: What are you writing?

lines.tts: [breezy, like reading out a to-do list] 安排一下。到了海南，第一件事，做棺材。
lines.zh: 安排一下。到了海南，第一件事，做棺材。
lines.en: Just planning ahead. Hainan, item one: make a coffin.

lines.tts: [shocked] 啊？
lines.en: What?

lines.tts: [same breezy tone] 第二件事，做坟。
lines.en: Item two: make a grave.

lines.tts: [scared to ask] 第三件呢？
lines.en: And item three?

lines.tts: [grinning] 找吃的。
lines.en: Find food.

card.zh: 他真的在信里写：到了海南，先做棺材，再做坟。
card.en: His real letter: in Hainan, first make a coffin, then a grave.

lines.tts: [to camera, trying to laugh and not managing] 他笑着写的。他觉得，自己回不来了。
lines.zh: 他笑着写的。他觉得，自己回不来了。
lines.en: He wrote it smiling. He thinks he's not coming back.

lines.tts: [playful, a riddle] 你猜，我这肚子里装的是什么？
lines.zh: 你猜，我这肚子里装的是什么？
lines.en: Guess what's in this belly of mine.

lines.tts: [guessing] 学问？
lines.en: Learning?

lines.tts: [shaking his head] 不对。
lines.en: Nope.

lines.tts: [guessing again] 文章？
lines.en: Poems?

lines.tts: [smiling, shaking his head] 也不对。
lines.en: Nope.

lines.tts: [fond, remembering] 只有她猜对了。她说，是一肚子不合时宜。[laughs]
lines.zh: 只有她猜对了。她说，是一肚子不合时宜。
screens: 她说，是一肚子不合时宜。
lines.en: Only she ever got it right. She said it was a bellyful of being out of step with the times.

lines.tts: [careful] 她是……？
lines.en: She was...?

lines.tts: [plain] 朝云。家里人都散了，只有她，跟我来了惠州。
lines.zh: 朝云。家里人都散了，只有她，跟我来了惠州。
lines.en: Zhaoyun. When I was banished, the household scattered. Only she came with me to Huizhou.

lines.tts: [steady, then cracking] 去年夏天，她病死在这儿。
lines.zh: 去年夏天，她病死在这儿。
lines.en: Last summer she fell ill and died here.

lines.tts: [to the grave, gentle, breaking] 明天，我去海南。这一回，带不走你了。
lines.zh: 明天，我去海南。这一回，带不走你了。
lines.en: Tomorrow I go to Hainan. This time I can't take you with me.

lines.tts: [smiling through it, warm] 走吧，明早还要赶路。
lines.en: Come on. Early start tomorrow.

lines.tts: [shouting back across the water, cheerful] 荔枝熟了，替我多吃几颗！
lines.zh: 荔枝熟了，替我多吃几颗！
screens: 荔枝熟了，替我多吃几颗！
lines.en: When the lychees ripen, eat a few for me!

lines.tts: [ecstatic, then conspiratorial] 这蚝太好吃了，千万别让北方人知道。
lines.zh: 这蚝太好吃了，千万别让北方人知道。
lines.en: These oysters are too good. Whatever you do, don't let anyone up north find out.

lines.tts: [puzzled] 为什么？
lines.en: Why not?

lines.tts: [dead serious] 他们会抢着被贬过来，分我的蚝。
lines.zh: 他们会抢着被贬过来，分我的蚝。
lines.en: They'll all scramble to get banished down here and eat my oysters.

card.zh: 这是真的。他一再叮嘱儿子别说，怕北方人来分。
card.en: True. He kept telling his son to keep quiet, for fear northerners would come to share.

lines.tts: [sincere] 您这辈子，最大的功业是什么？
lines.zh: 您这辈子，最大的功业是什么？
lines.en: What was the greatest achievement of your life?

lines.tts: [old, warm, simple] 黄州，惠州，儋州。
lines.en: Huangzhou. Huizhou. Danzhou.

card.zh: 两个月后，他病逝在北归路上的常州。
card.en: Two months later, on his way home north, he died in Changzhou.
